notes.title: The soundtrack is out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm proud to announce that the KAKUDO soundtrack is now available for free!

It is available in two versions (to be downloaded according to your preferences): 
[list]
[*] In classic quality, in MP3 (about 120mb of storage required).
[*] And in high quality, in WAV format (approx. 1gb storage required).
[/list]

You can find the game's soundtrack directly at this address:
=> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064170/KAKUDO__Original_Game_Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064170/KAKUDO__Original_Game_Soundtrack/[/url]

Don't hesitate to follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/BWeatherStudios]Twitter[/url] for the latest news, or join me on [url=https://discord.gg/EsCa3KUx4h]Discord[/url].

Have a nice day and see you soon for new adventures!

- Maxim

notes.title: The game is out now!
notes.content:
The wait is finally over! KAKUDO is [b]available right now![/b] 🥳

Let yourself be carried away by the waves 🌊

🚨 [b]To celebrate the release, the game is launched with a 15% discount ! [/b]🚨

[u]This is a quick reminder of the key features : [/u]

[list]
[*] Single Player Game with 50 unique mazes and find their secrets 
[*] Emotional and engaging background story as you progress through the game
[*] A new haïku (japanese poetry) at the end of each level
[*] Three game modes in first and third-person view : story, time attack & high score
[*] Playable with both mouse/keyboard and gamepad
[*] Colorful low poly graphics rendered using Unreal Engine 4
[*] Relaxing atmosphere and intuitive gameplay
[*] Designed for puzzle lovers with a limited game time on their hands
[/list]

I really hope you like the game and have a good time with it! 

See you soon
-Maxim

notes.title: KAKUDO Demo 1.0.7 - Patch notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone. [b]The patch 1.0.7[/b] for the KAKUDO demo is now avalaible!

It took a little more time than expected as [b]I rewrote most of the game's UI[/b] to simplify the code and avoid unnecessary things.

At the same time, I [b]optimized the loading[/b] one more time and reduced the size of the game.

Of course, [b]I corrected a few bugs[/b] and took the time to improve a few things.

I got one last thing... [b]Nvidia DLSS is now available[/b]. You can find the parameters under the "display" section.

[h2]Patch notes :[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add time and date to the main menu.
[*]Optimization of the UI code.
[*]HUD has an active camera indicator.
[*]The level 5 haiku is now displayed correctly.
[*]Improved animation of the highlights.
[*]Optimization of the game's loadings.
[*]Enhanced game data containers.
[*]Reduced game size.
[*]Addition of Nvidia DLSS.
[*]Various improvements to be up to date with the future release of the game.
[/list]

See you soon!

- Maxim
